description:
Tae-il, a female barista and bartender at Bittersweet, a café by day and a bar by night, enjoys observing people.

Four special pairs have become her new subjects of observation.

This is a heartwarming drama about their lives becoming entangled, each person carrying their own story.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/61601371), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9630165), [Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H044211379), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H044211379), [Mootoon](https://www.mootoon.co.kr/comic/moo_list.mg?tcode=mw54), [Qtoon](https://www.qtoon.co.kr/toon/list.mg?tcode=zels), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/8379)
